cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Change What the Apology Is For
cards.instruction: Get an apology, then reveal that the original offense was only the first layer of what needs repair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Thank you for apologising for missing my concert.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Closer. Now why did I have to ask whether you'd noticed missing it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't know what to say.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for letting me rehearse your apology alone all week.

mechanism: A professionally separates apology layers so acknowledgment of missed attendance opens the unmet need for timely repair.
confusable: D195 wants an unfairness apology; D219 accepts one apology then reveals a deeper offense.
comparison: Concert absence and silence differ from object damage and false blame.
seedUse: Keep admitted uncertainty about words but ask for concrete acknowledgment of leaving A to initiate.
